neighbours.label: the word after 'as' in a parenthetical 'as it did' / 'as it was' clause (situated as it was, mirroring as it did)
fire: The plan was popular, promising as it did a fairer share of the land.
The fort was hard to supply, perched as it was on a narrow ridge above the sea.
The town was spared the worst of the storm, sheltered as it was by the hills.
The speech was ignored, coming as it did on the eve of the election.
The garden stayed cool all summer, shaded as it was by three old oaks.
His theory was dismissed, contradicting as it did everything taught at the time.
The village grew slowly, isolated as it was from the main roads.
The decision angered many, arriving as it did without any warning.
quiet: The plan was popular because it promised a fairer share of the land.

The town was spared the worst of the storm because the hills sheltered it.
The speech was ignored because it came on the eve of the election.
The garden stayed cool all summer because three old oaks shaded it.
His theory was dismissed because it contradicted everything taught at the time.
The village grew slowly because it was far from the main roads.
